content.headline: The BNMS General Fund
content.subheadline: Supporting nuclear medicine where it is needed most.

content.html:
The BNMS General Fund allows the Society to invest in the areas where support can have the greatest impact. Unlike dedicated funds, these donations provide the flexibility to respond to emerging priorities, support new initiatives and strengthen the future of nuclear medicine.

Your support helps the British Nuclear Medicine Society continue its work on behalf of healthcare professionals, patients and the wider nuclear medicine community.
Support the future of nuclear medicine
• Supporting educational meetings, professional development and learning opportunities for nuclear medicine professionals.
• Encouraging innovation, sharing knowledge and advancing the science and practice of nuclear medicine.

content.body: Educational programmes, conferences and professional development opportunities.
content.heading: Education & development

content.body: Student support, research initiatives and investment in the future workforce.
content.heading: Future growth

content.body: Guidance, standards, patient information and representation of the specialty.
content.heading: Professional practice

content.html: • Supporting the next generation of practitioners through educational opportunities and development initiatives.
• Developing guidance, promoting best practice and supporting safe and effective patient care.
Donations to the General Fund enable BNMS to invest in activities that benefit the entire nuclear medicine community.
Your support gives BNMS the flexibility to respond to new opportunities and invest where it can make the greatest difference.
• The General Fund enables BNMS to respond to changing priorities and emerging opportunities across the specialty.
• Every contribution helps strengthen education, research, professional development and patient care for future generations.

content.headline: Help Shape the Future of Nuclear Medicine
content.subheadline: Your support helps BNMS invest in education, innovation and professional excellence.

content.html:
Every donation, large or small, contributes to the continued development of nuclear medicine in the United Kingdom.

If there is a particular area of work that you would like your donation to support, we would be pleased to discuss your wishes.

Thank you for supporting the work of the British Nuclear Medicine Society.
